card.name: Disposal of used syringes and needles
card.fires_on: Small linking words like into, in, or a right after discard or dispose of a used syringe, needle, or implant, just before the container is named (sharps container).

modes.label: into/in after discard
modes.description: The preposition follows discard or dispose of a syringe or implant, ahead of the receptacle.
modes.example: Remove syringe from NLAD (if applicable) and discard<< into>> appropriate receptacle.

modes.label: article before sharps container
modes.description: The word a comes after discard into, just before sharps container.
modes.example: discard the syringe into<< a>> sharps disposal container or in accordance with

card.writes: It pushes the model toward needle and sharps words, which fits the container that comes next.
card.plain: It fires on the little word after 'discard' or 'dispose of' a used syringe, where the sharps container is about to be named.
evidence: Remove syringe from NLAD (if applicable) and discard<< into>> appropriate receptacle.
Dispose of the syringe<< in>> an approved sharps collector.
Immediately dispose of the used syringe into<< a>> sharps container.
